Subject: Acceptance drivers & dependencies for Redwood MAP

Kimberly —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to lock a binding timeline for procurement and legal so internal stakeholders can calendar their review windows. High-level asks from my side:

- Can you share a MAP that enumerates the evaluation milestones + deliverables (technical eval, security evidence, legal redlines, PO/order form sign)?
- We need the SOC2 snapshot and the list of evidence artifacts you'll supply for our compliance team.
- Target signature window: client exec approval week of 2026-08-09; procurement needs a finalized order form + SOW by 2026-08-05 to hit that.

If you can send a draft MAP today with clear owners and minimum lead times for legal reviews (MSA/DPA/order form), Tom and I will work backwards and flag any internal blockers. I've attached our internal procurement template (see Procurement_Schedule_v3.pdf) for reference.

Thanks —
Sarah Lopez
Head of Strategic Procurement
BindPoint Systems

Sarah —

Appreciate the clarity. I've attached a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short evidence checklist (SOC2-evidence-list.pdf). High-level sequence and recommended windows below (we kept the signature target aligned with your 08/09 exec week):

- Technical evaluation (P0): 2026-07-22 → 2026-07-28 — deliverable: eval report + sample queries; owner: BindPoint eng + Redwood SE (Grace).
- Security snapshot & artifacts: deliver by 2026-07-26 (SOC2 snapshot, encryption details, KMS integration notes).
- Legal redline cycle (MSA blueline): initial redline received 2026-07-27, Redwood returns consolidated comments 2026-07-30 — owner: BindPoint legal + Redwood legal.
- DPA review: concurrent with MSA redlines, final DPA sign-off 2026-08-03.
- Order form + PO: draft order form ready 2026-07-31; final PO and order form signed by 2026-08-05.
- Signature (exec): target week 2026-08-09.

We can compress the legal loop by 3 business days if BindPoint is okay with a conditional signature flow: sign order form with an appendix that holds final MSA redlines until 08/20 and establishes an interim fallback SLA. Karthik (legal) has prudential guidance on that option — cc'd.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-list.pdf, MSA-blueline.docx

Next steps: please confirm procurement owner for the PO, and whether your legal team prefers a redline or a comment-only pass on the MSA blueline.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Lopez <slopez@bindpoint.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@bindpoint.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance drivers & dependencies for Redwood MAP

Quick notes from legal on sequencing and negotiation levers — posting here so everyone has the same playbook: 

1) Preferred sequence: MSA (redline) -> DPA finalization -> Order form signature. That keeps core obligations clear before invoicing.
2) Conditional-sign approach (acceptable): order form signed with a limited escrow/holdback clause + explicit acceptance criteria. Use when procurement timing is hard-fixed. Escrow period should be no longer than 30 days.
3) SLA/credits: any interim SLA in a conditional sign must be paired with a capped credits ladder and a defined regression test with a mutually agreed prompt set (we can provide a draft test harness).
4) Evidence window: SOC2 snapshot + annotated evidence (logs access, retention policy, KMS attestation) — we can prepare a redacted package to ship by 07/26.
5) Fast-track tips: if BindPoint assigns a senior GC to do one consolidated pass (versus multiple SMEs), we can typically turn redlines in 48–72 hours.

I'll be available to triage legal comments as they come in; recommend a 30-minute legal-to-legal sync on 2026-07-28 to close open clauses.

— Karthik Iyer
VP Legal, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lopez <slopez@bindpoint.com>

Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@bindpoint.com>, procure@bindpoint.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance drivers & dependencies for Redwood MAP

Kimberly / team —

Thanks — the MAP looks actionable and the timeline aligns with our internal calendar. A few confirmations from procurement/legal here: 

- Procurement owner: Tom Hsu will be owner for the PO and confirms the 08/05 order form finish target.
- SOC2 evidence: our security SME will accept a redacted snapshot by 07/26; Tom will route to GC for the DPA check.
- Legal path: we prefer an initial comment-only pass on the MSA blueline and will expedite a consolidated redline if needed.
- On conditional sign: Tom confirms procurement is open to a conditional order form signature if you provide the escrow/holdback language and interim SLA ladder.

We will:
- Provide consolidated MSA comments by 07/30.
- Deliver SOC2 snapshot package by 07/26.
- Confirm PO/finance timeline by 08/03 (target to finalize PO on 08/05).

If that tracks, let's lock the legal-to-legal sync on 07/28 at 10:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Sarah Lopez

BindPoint Systems
